summaries.en: The paper proves that for a fixed Lorentz boost causing a Wigner rotation with uncertain momentum, one gets strict contraction of all pairwise spin trace distances without any CPTP map that would make the less-contracted channel degradable to the more-contracted one, fully characterizing a spin-1/2 Pauli-family cone and exactly computing the optimal diamond-norm deficiency while showing members are pairwise incomparable under post-processing and none (except the identity) embeds into a time-homogeneous Pauli-diagonal Lindblad semigroup.
summaries.zh: 本文证明：在固定洛伦兹洛伦兹(boost)作用并因不确定动量导致的韦格纳旋转下，所有自旋态两两的迹距离都会严格收缩，但不会出现任何CPTP后处理使“收缩更少”的通道可由“收缩更多”的通道降解；作者对自旋1/2情形精确刻画了由固定韦格纳角与横向动量方向生成的保利家族锥体，精确计算了最优diamond范数缺陷，并表明该家族中除恒等元外的各非恒等噪声成员在CPTP后处理下两两不可比，且它们都不能嵌入到时间同质的保利对角Lindblad半群中，从而说明仅凭未辅助自旋可区分度的排序无法决定量子统计后处理的偏序关系。

title: Spin Chain Quantum Communication on a Trapped-Ion Processor
abstract: Efficient communication between distant qubits is one of the central challenges in scaling quantum processors. Although engineered spin chain protocols have been extensively investigated theoretically, their experimental realization has remained comparatively limited. Here, we experimentally realize engineered quantum communication protocols through digitally simulated spin Hamiltonian on IonQ's Forte 1/ Forte Enterprise 1 trapped-ion quantum processor. Combining exact numerical simulations with quantum hardware experiments, we benchmark uniform nearest-neighbour and engineered coupling profiles and demonstrate that engineered interactions significantly enhance the fidelity of quantum state transfer. We further show that exploiting the commutation structure of the spin Hamiltonian enables a parallel Trotter decomposition that more faithfully reproduces the target dynamics while substantially reducing the circuit depth and execution time compared to the conventional sequential implementations. Our results demonstrate that programmable quantum processors can effectively realize and efficiently implement quantum communication protocols, bringing Hamiltonian-based quantum communication closer to practical quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates engineered spin-chain quantum communication on an IonQ trapped-ion processor by digitally simulating spin Hamiltonians, showing that tailored couplings improve state-transfer fidelity and that using the Hamiltonian’s commutation structure enables a parallel Trotter method that reduces circuit depth and runtime while better matching the target dynamics.
summaries.zh: 论文在IonQ俘获离子处理器上通过数字模拟自旋哈密顿量，实验证明了工程化自旋链量子通信；结果表明定制耦合能显著提升量子态转移保真度，并且利用该哈密顿量的对易结构可进行并行Trotter分解，从而在更准确复现目标动力学的同时大幅降低电路深度与执行时间。

title: Coherence enhancement of Rydberg polaritons
abstract: Quantum nonlinear optics by Rydberg polaritons can enable single-photon transistor and switch, single-photon source, and deterministic quantum information processing. A major hindrance in this study is the fast motional decoherence. Here, we devise a scheme to significantly enhance the coherence of Rydberg polariton by letting the atoms {\it remember} their velocities, or, alternatively, by {\it changing} the phase of Rydberg polariton according to its storage time. After the Rydberg polariton is prepared with a Rydberg state $|r_1\rangle$, i.e., during the storage time, two laser fields induce a transition between $|r_1\rangle$ and a nearby Rydberg state $|r_2\rangle$ via a low-lying intermediate state $\lvert f\rangle$ which is largely detuned. In particular, we find that either a $2\pi\mathbb{N}$ protocol, a $\pi$-wait-$\pi$ protocol, or a wait-$\pi$ protocol, along with an appropriate choice of $\lvert f\rangle$ can lead to a phase-coherent Rydberg polariton upon its retrieval. Importantly, the coherent transition between $|r_1\rangle$ and $|r_2\rangle$ ensures that the Rydberg polariton can block the Rydberg excitation of nearby atoms as in usual applications of Rydberg polaritons. Numerics show that the theory can nearly completely eliminate the motional dephasing, leaving Rydberg-state decay as the only fundamental channel of decoherence. This sheds light on a broad application of Rydberg-mediated quantum nonlinear optics.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes protocols that enhance the coherence of Rydberg polaritons by making atoms effectively retain their velocities or by imprinting phase shifts during storage via controlled transitions between Rydberg states, enabling nearly complete suppression of motional dephasing while preserving Rydberg-polariton blocking functionality for quantum nonlinear optics.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并分析了通过让原子在存储期间“记住”速度或对存储时间施加相应相位的方法来增强里德伯极化子的相干性，具体通过在两相近里德伯态之间借助远失谐中间态的受控跃迁实现2πN、π-等待-π或等待-π等协议，从而几乎完全抑制动量去相干并保留里德伯极化子对邻近原子里德伯激发的阻断能力。

title: A cryogenic neutral-atom platform with full optical access and 2-hour trap lifetime
abstract: Neutral-atom quantum processors are rapidly scaling toward system sizes of more than ten thousand qubits, allowing for the realization of a new class of quantum computing algorithms and quantum simulation experiments. However, current neutral-atom platforms generally have to find a compromise between the optical accessibility and the storage time of atoms in optical potentials, limiting the available qubit numbers. Here we report on the operation of a novel, cryogenically enhanced, neutral-atom apparatus that overcomes these apparently conflicting requirements. We demonstrate vacuum-limited trapping lifetimes of up to two hours of single $^{88}\mathrm{Sr}$ atoms in an optical tweezer array while preserving full optical access and without the need for complex cryogenic enclosures. Our measurements show that exceptionally long single-atom lifetimes can be achieved with a relatively simple cryostat design. Our architecture can be straightforwardly ported to other atomic species and shows a viable path for scaling up to sorted arrays of tens of thousands of atoms.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper presents a cryogenically enhanced neutral-atom platform that maintains full optical access while achieving vacuum-limited trapping lifetimes up to two hours for single 88Sr atoms in an optical tweezer array, using a relatively simple cryostat design and outlining scalability to tens of thousands of atoms and other species.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种经低温增强的中性原子平台，在保持光学完全可访问的同时，实现了光学镊子阵列中单个88Sr原子的真空限制俘获寿命最高达两小时，且借助相对简单的低温装置设计，并展望可扩展到上万量级并可迁移到其他原子物种。

title: High-fidelity entanglement of polar molecules by dynamic geometric control
abstract: In quantum information systems made of optical tweezer arrays of ultracold molecules, thermal motion of molecules degrades the coherence of their interactions, which limits entanglement fidelity and the concomitant scientific applicability of these systems. We show that by controlling the geometry of the dipolar interaction, even when a molecule occupies many motional states in the tweezer, coherence can be preserved. We characterize several geometries that suppress sensitivity to thermal fluctuations. We further use programmable, coherence-preserving motion of the molecules during entanglement to refocus dephasing from relative positional jitter of the tweezers, which is relevant even on the 10 nm scale. These methods yield substantially improved dipolar coherence and enable generation of two-molecule entanglement with a Bell state fidelity of $\mathcal{F}= 0.976^{+0.008}_{-0.011}$ in directly laser-cooled molecules.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that high-fidelity entanglement of ultracold polar molecules in optical tweezer arrays can be achieved by dynamically controlling the geometry of dipolar interactions to suppress thermal-motion sensitivity and by using programmable coherence-preserving motion to refocus dephasing from tweezer position jitter, yielding a Bell-state fidelity of 0.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，通过动态控制光镊中超冷极性分子的偶极相互作用几何形状以抑制热运动对相干性的敏感性，并利用可编程的相干保持运动来抵消光镊位置抖动引起的退相干，可以实现高保真纠缠，得到的贝尔态保真度为0.
